full_judgment: 53. PW 13, Md Nawab Mia stated in his deposition that on. 11-8-2005 police in his presence held inquest of the dead bodies of the deceased Aktar Hossain, Sabrina Afroz Juli and Arna Akter and prepared the inquest report. He exhibited his signatures on the inquest reports as Exhibits 2/2, 3/2 and 4/2 respectively. Defence declines to cross-examine him.
